items.name: ReSO AI
items.description: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI. ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

raw_data.tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI

items.name: Onepin
items.description: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right. AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

raw_data.tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right

items.name: Claude Dashboards & Motion
items.description: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers. Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

raw_data.tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers

items.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
items.description: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

raw_data.tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows

items.name: Skreno
items.description: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser. Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

raw_data.tagline: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser

items.name: Maildun for Mac
items.description: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP. Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

items.name: ej
items.description: An 11MB local model for typed decisions in one pass. I built ej for a narrower problem than general classification: given some state and a set of decision questions whose options can be defined at runtime, return a probability distribution for each question in one pass. It handles choice, yes/no, and ordered scores, runs on CPU, needs no token generation, and ships as one 11.4 MB model file. The repo includes training, evaluation, adaptation, packed weights, and the benchmark harness.

raw_data.tagline: An 11MB local model for typed decisions in one pass
